sideB: AddAction.IsPreprimitive ↥(fixingAddSubgroup (↥(AddAction.stabilizer G a)) t) ↥(SubAddAction.ofFixingAddSubgroup (↥(AddAction.stabilizer G a)) t)
statement: AddAction.IsPreprimitive ↥(fixingAddSubgroup G (insert a (Subtype.val '' t))) ↥(SubAddAction.ofFixingAddSubgroup G (insert a (Subtype.val '' t))) ↔ AddAction.IsPreprimitive ↥(fixingAddSubgroup (↥(AddAction.stabilizer G a)) t) ↥(SubAddAction.ofFixingAddSubgroup (↥(AddAction.stabilizer G a)) t)

binders: {α : Type u_1} [Zero α] (a : αˢʸᵐ)
statement: SymAlg.unsym a = 0 ↔ a = 0

binders: {α : Type u_1} [Zero α] (a : αˢʸᵐ)
statement: SymAlg.unsym a ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0

binders: {α : Type u_4} {inst : Semiring α} {inst : PartialOrder α} [self : FloorSemiring α] {a : α} {n : ℕ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
statement: n ≤ FloorSemiring.floor a ↔ ↑n ≤ a

binders: {G : Type u_1} [AddGroup G] {p : Prop} {K : p → AddSubgroup G} {x : G}
statement: x ∈ ⨆ (h : p), K h ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ (h : p), x ∈ K h

binders: {M : Type u_1} [AddZeroClass M] {p : Prop} {S : p → AddSubmonoid M} {x : M}
statement: x ∈ ⨆ (h : p), S h ↔ x = 0 ∨ ∃ (h : p), x ∈ S h
